title: Cook a new recipe together
description: Pick a cuisine you've never made at home and follow a recipe together, mistakes and all.

title: Sunset walk with no phones
description: Leave phones at home and take a walk somewhere with a good view as the sun goes down.

title: Try a board game night
description: Pick a new board or card game neither of you has played and learn it together.

title: Visit a local market you've never been to
description: Explore stalls, try a snack you've never had, people-watch.

title: Stargazing
description: Find a spot away from city lights, bring a blanket, and just talk under the stars.

title: Recreate your first date
description: Go back to wherever you had your first date, or recreate it as closely as you can.

title: Take a dance class together
description: Salsa, swing, anything neither of you knows — laugh through the awkward parts.

title: Build a joint playlist
description: Each add 10 songs that mean something to you and explain why, over a slow evening in.

title: Day trip to somewhere neither of you has been
description: Pick somewhere within an hour's drive or matatu ride and just go.

title: Write letters to future you two
description: Each write a letter to open together in a year. Seal it, put a date on the calendar.
